subject: Request: extend trial window while procurement finalizes
messages:
From: Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@helio-sys.com>
To: dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: procurement@helio-sys.com
Date: Wed, 5 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Trial extension request — procurement delay

Hi Dev,

Quick note — procurement has flagged the SOW review and PO issuance and told us it will take an extra week to clear (they need one more security attachment and a copy of our payments contact). The product evaluation is mid-way and the team wants to keep using the Redwood trial while procurement sorts the PO.

Would Redwood be able to extend our trial window by 7–10 days and add a small buffer of credits so we don’t hit the quota while procurement finishes? We don’t have a formal PO yet but procurement@helio-sys.com is on the thread; they expect a PO by 2025-11-15.

Thanks — we really want to keep momentum on the pilot.

— Maria
Maria Gonzalez
Head of Platform Integrations
Helio Systems
[maria.gonzalez@helio-sys.com]

Attachments referenced: SOW_draft_v2.pdf (we attached an earlier version to procurement)
From: dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood-inference.com>
To: Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@helio-sys.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood-inference.com>, markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood-inference.com>, procurement@helio-sys.com
Date: Thu, 6 Nov 2025 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Trial extension request — procurement delay

Hi Maria — thanks for the heads-up and for looping procurement.

We can absolutely accommodate while your procurement team finishes the PO. A couple quick questions to set expectations so I can escalate:
- What date does procurement expect to send the PO? (you mentioned 11/15)
- Do you need any additional compliance docs from us besides the SOW? I can route to Security if so.

I’m cc’ing Lauren and Markus from my team to request approval for a short-term extension + promotional credits while procurement closes. If we get sign-off I can apply the extension and credits today so your engineers don’t get blocked.

If helpful, I can also send a DocuSign link for an interim SOW amendment to avoid any tooling interruptions.

Best,
Dev Patel
Account Executive — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
Dev: +1 (415) 555-0192
[attachment stub: trial-invoice-helio.xlsx]
From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood-inference.com>
To: dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood-inference.com>, markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Sat, 8 Nov 2025 08:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Trial extension request — procurement delay

Thanks for the flag. Approve giving Helio Systems a 7-day extension plus 2,000 promotional credits to cover the evaluation while procurement finalizes the PO. Please update HubSpot (DEAL-4781) and add a note specifying the extension window (2025-11-12 through 2025-11-19) and credit amount.

Guidance:
- Extension only; do not change pricing or long-term commitments.
- If procurement requires additional security evidence, route to Security (cc: security@redwood-inference.com) — do not provide production keys.

Markus: if you can prepare the DocuSign amendment and the interim SOW update, that would be great. Dev — confirm to Maria once credits are applied and share the DS link.

— Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Sr. Manager, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
From: dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood-inference.com>
To: Maria Gonzalez <maria.gonzalez@helio-sys.com>, procurement@helio-sys.com
Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood-inference.com>, markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Nov 2025 15:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Trial extension request — procurement delay

Maria — good news: we applied the 7-day extension and added 2,000 trial credits to your account. Your trial window has been extended from 2025-11-12 through 2025-11-19.

I attached an interim SOW (SOW_draft_v2.pdf) and the DocuSign link below for a simple amendment that notes the PO timeline and confirms scope during the trial. Signing the amendment will help procurement close faster but is not required for the extension we applied.

DocuSign amendment: https://www.docusign.com/en/helio/sow-4781
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/4781
